
/* ---------- Kontak WA wajib Nama depan + No. WhatsApp (5 Nov 2026, permintaan Jess) ----------
 * Klik link WhatsApp mana pun di web (tombol melayang, halaman/kartu produk, sales, footer, Product Inquiry)
 * → popup Nama depan + No. WhatsApp (wajib, centang promo opsional) → dicatat ke {prefix}ac_wa_lead → WhatsApp terbuka.
 * Pesan WA ditambah nama ("saya Rina dari website"); kode #W, log Klik WhatsApp & konversi Google Ads tetap jalan
 * (terhitung saat WhatsApp benar-benar dibuka). Data tersimpan di browser (localStorage ac_wl, 180 hari) → klik berikutnya
 * tidak ditanya lagi, tetap tercatat. Laporan & export CSV: wp-admin → Kontak WA.
 * Staff yang login (admin bar) tidak ditanya; tes: ?acwa=1 (data ditandai staff), ?acwa=reset hapus data di browser.
 */
define( 'AC_WL_DBV', '1' );

function ac_wl_table() {
	global $wpdb;
	return $wpdb->prefix . 'ac_wa_lead';
}

function ac_wl_install() {
	if ( AC_WL_DBV === get_option( 'ac_wl_dbv' ) ) {
		return;
	}
	global $wpdb;
	require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php';
	dbDelta( 'CREATE TABLE ' . ac_wl_table() . " (
		id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
		t datetime NOT NULL,
		hp varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		nama varchar(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		promo tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
		tipe varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		ke varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		btn varchar(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		item varchar(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		page varchar(190) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		src varchar(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		lp varchar(190) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		dev varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		kode varchar(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		staff tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
		PRIMARY KEY  (id),
		KEY hp (hp),
		KEY t (t)
	) " . $wpdb->get_charset_collate() . ';' );
	update_option( 'ac_wl_dbv', AC_WL_DBV, false );
}
add_action( 'admin_init', 'ac_wl_install' );

/* Nomor → format internasional tanpa +, mis. 0812-3456-7890 → 6281234567890. Kosong kalau tidak valid. */
function ac_wl_hp( $v ) {
	$v    = trim( (string) $v );
	$plus = 0 === strpos( $v, '+' );
	$d    = preg_replace( '/\D/', '', $v );
	if ( 0 === strpos( $d, '00' ) ) {
		$d = substr( $d, 2 );
	} elseif ( ! $plus && 0 === strpos( $d, '0' ) ) {
		$d = '62' . substr( $d, 1 );
	} elseif ( ! $plus && 0 === strpos( $d, '8' ) ) {
		$d = '62' . $d;
	}
	if ( 0 === strpos( $d, '620' ) ) {
		$d = '62' . substr( $d, 3 );
	}
	if ( strlen( $d ) < 9 || strlen( $d ) > 15 ) {
		return '';
	}
	if ( 0 === strpos( $d, '62' ) && ! preg_match( '/^628\d{7,11}$/', $d ) ) {
		return '';
	}
	return $d;
}

function ac_wl_nama( $v ) {
	$v = sanitize_text_field( (string) $v );
	$v = preg_replace( '/[\d<>"@#$%^*_=+{}\[\]|\\\\\/;:~`]+/u', '', $v );
	$v = trim( preg_replace( '/\s+/u', ' ', $v ) );
	$v = mb_substr( $v, 0, 40 );
	if ( mb_strlen( $v ) < 2 ) {
		return '';
	}
	return mb_strtoupper( mb_substr( $v, 0, 1 ) ) . mb_substr( $v, 1 );
}

/* Simpan satu kontak. Dipakai popup (AJAX) dan form custom order (s38). */
function ac_wl_add( array $d ) {
	$hp   = ac_wl_hp( isset( $d['hp'] ) ? $d['hp'] : '' );
	$nama = ac_wl_nama( isset( $d['nama'] ) ? $d['nama'] : '' );
	if ( '' === $hp || '' === $nama ) {
		return false;
	}
	ac_wl_install();
	$s = function ( $k, $len ) use ( $d ) {
		return isset( $d[ $k ] ) ? mb_substr( sanitize_text_field( (string) $d[ $k ] ), 0, $len ) : '';
	};
	global $wpdb;
	return (bool) $wpdb->insert(
		ac_wl_table(),
		array(
			't'     => current_time( 'mysql' ),
			'hp'    => $hp,
			'nama'  => $nama,
			'promo' => empty( $d['promo'] ) ? 0 : 1,
			'tipe'  => $s( 'tipe', 10 ),
			'ke'    => preg_replace( '/\D/', '', $s( 'ke', 20 ) ),
			'btn'   => $s( 'btn', 40 ),
			'item'  => $s( 'item', 150 ),
			'page'  => $s( 'page', 190 ),
			'src'   => $s( 'src', 60 ),
			'lp'    => $s( 'lp', 190 ),
			'dev'   => $s( 'dev', 10 ),
			'kode'  => strtoupper( preg_replace( '/[^A-Za-z0-9]/', '', $s( 'kode', 8 ) ) ),
			'staff' => is_user_logged_in() ? 1 : 0,
		)
	);
}

function ac_wl_ajax() {
	$ua = isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ) ? (string) $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] : ''; // phpcs:ignore
	$p  = wp_unslash( $_POST ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification -- endpoint publik (halaman di-cache), dibatasi rate limit.
	$tp = isset( $p['tipe'] ) ? (string) $p['tipe'] : '';
	if ( '' === $ua || preg_match( '/bot|crawl|spider|slurp|headless|lighthouse|facebookexternalhit/i', $ua )
		|| ! empty( $p['web'] ) || ! in_array( $tp, array( 'form', 'klik' ), true )
		|| ( 'form' === $tp && isset( $p['ms'] ) && (int) $p['ms'] < 250 ) ) {
		status_header( 204 );
		exit;
	}
	$ip = isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP'] ) ? (string) $_SERVER['HTTP_CF_CONNECTING_IP'] : ( isset( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ) ? (string) $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] : '' ); // phpcs:ignore
	$rk = 'ac_wl_rl_' . md5( $ip );
	$n  = (int) get_transient( $rk );
	if ( $n >= 20 ) {
		status_header( 204 );
		exit;
	}
	set_transient( $rk, $n + 1, 10 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS );
	ac_wl_add( array_intersect_key( (array) $p, array_flip( array( 'hp', 'nama', 'promo', 'tipe', 'ke', 'btn', 'item', 'page', 'src', 'lp', 'dev', 'kode' ) ) ) );
	status_header( 204 );
	exit;
}
add_action( 'wp_ajax_ac_wl', 'ac_wl_ajax' );
add_action( 'wp_ajax_nopriv_ac_wl', 'ac_wl_ajax' );

/* ---------- Laporan wp-admin: Kontak WA ---------- */
function ac_wl_names() {
	return function_exists( 'ac_wa_names' ) ? ac_wa_names() : array();
}

/* 6281234567890 → 0812-3456-7890 (nomor luar negeri: +kode…) */
function ac_wl_fmt( $hp ) {
	if ( 0 !== strpos( $hp, '62' ) ) {
		return '+' . $hp;
	}
	$l = '0' . substr( $hp, 2 );
	return substr( $l, 0, 4 ) . '-' . substr( $l, 4, 4 ) . '-' . substr( $l, 8 );
}

/* Filter dari URL: d = hari (0 = semua), q = cari nama/nomor, promo = 1, staff = 1 (ikutkan tes staff) */
function ac_wl_filters() {
	$g = function ( $k ) {
		return isset( $_GET[ $k ] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET[ $k ] ) ) : ''; // phpcs:ignore
	};
	return array(
		'd'     => '' === $g( 'd' ) ? 0 : max( 0, min( 3650, (int) $g( 'd' ) ) ),
		'q'     => mb_substr( $g( 'q' ), 0, 60 ),
		'promo' => '1' === $g( 'promo' ),
		'staff' => '1' === $g( 'staff' ),
	);
}

/* Query kontak per nomor. Mengembalikan array( rows, total ). */
function ac_wl_rows( $f, $limit = 200, $offset = 0 ) {
	global $wpdb;
	$tb    = ac_wl_table();
	$where = $f['staff'] ? '1=1' : 'staff = 0';
	if ( '' !== $f['q'] ) {
		$like  = '%' . $wpdb->esc_like( $f['q'] ) . '%';
		$dig   = preg_replace( '/\D/', '', $f['q'] );
		$dlike = '' !== $dig ? '%' . $wpdb->esc_like( 0 === strpos( $dig, '0' ) ? substr( $dig, 1 ) : $dig ) . '%' : $like;
		$where .= $wpdb->prepare( " AND hp IN (SELECT hp FROM $tb WHERE nama LIKE %s OR hp LIKE %s)", $like, $dlike ); // phpcs:ignore
	}
	$having = array();
	if ( $f['d'] ) {
		$having[] = $wpdb->prepare( 'MAX(t) >= %s', wp_date( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - $f['d'] * DAY_IN_SECONDS ) );
	}
	if ( $f['promo'] ) {
		$having[] = 'MAX(promo) = 1';
	}
	$hv  = $having ? ' HAVING ' . implode( ' AND ', $having ) : '';
	$sel = "SELECT hp,
		SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(nama ORDER BY id DESC SEPARATOR '\\n'), '\\n', 1) AS nama,
		MIN(t) AS t1, MAX(t) AS t2, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(promo) AS promo,
		SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(ke ORDER BY id DESC SEPARATOR '\\n'), '\\n', 1) AS ke,
		SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(btn ORDER BY id DESC SEPARATOR '\\n'), '\\n', 1) AS btn,
		SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(IF(item <> '', item, page) ORDER BY id DESC SEPARATOR '\\n'), '\\n', 1) AS lastp,
		SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(src ORDER BY id ASC SEPARATOR '\\n'), '\\n', 1) AS src
		FROM $tb WHERE $where GROUP BY hp $hv";
	$total = (int) $wpdb->get_var( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ($sel) x" ); // phpcs:ignore
	$rows  = $wpdb->get_results( $sel . ' ORDER BY t2 DESC LIMIT ' . (int) $limit . ' OFFSET ' . (int) $offset ); // phpcs:ignore
	return array( $rows, $total );
}

add_action( 'admin_menu', function () {
	add_menu_page( 'Kontak WA', 'Kontak WA', 'edit_others_posts', 'ac-kontak-wa', 'ac_wl_page', 'dashicons-whatsapp', 27 );
} );

/* Export CSV (sebelum header admin dikirim) */
add_action( 'admin_init', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['page'] ) || 'ac-kontak-wa' !== $_GET['page'] || empty( $_GET['csv'] ) ) { // phpcs:ignore
		return;
	}
	if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_others_posts' ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( isset( $_GET['_wpnonce'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET['_wpnonce'] ) ) : '', 'ac_wl_csv' ) ) {
		wp_die( 'Tidak diizinkan.' );
	}
	list( $rows ) = ac_wl_rows( ac_wl_filters(), 100000, 0 );
	$names        = ac_wl_names();
	nocache_headers();
	header( 'Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8' );
	header( 'Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=kontak-wa-allesscia-' . wp_date( 'Ymd-Hi' ) . '.csv' );
	$out = fopen( 'php://output', 'w' );
	fwrite( $out, "\xEF\xBB\xBF" ); // phpcs:ignore -- BOM agar Excel membaca UTF-8
	fputcsv( $out, array( 'Nama', 'No WhatsApp', 'No HP', 'Mau promo', 'Pertama kontak', 'Terakhir kontak', 'Jumlah chat', 'Terakhir ke', 'Tombol terakhir', 'Produk / halaman terakhir', 'Sumber awal' ) );
	foreach ( $rows as $r ) {
		fputcsv(
			$out,
			array(
				$r->nama,
				$r->hp,
				ac_wl_fmt( $r->hp ),
				$r->promo ? 'Ya' : 'Tidak',
				mysql2date( 'd/m/Y H:i', $r->t1 ),
				mysql2date( 'd/m/Y H:i', $r->t2 ),
				(int) $r->n,
				isset( $names[ $r->ke ] ) ? $names[ $r->ke ] : $r->ke,
				$r->btn,
				$r->lastp,
				$r->src,
			)
		);
	}
	fclose( $out ); // phpcs:ignore
	exit;
} );

function ac_wl_page() {
	global $wpdb;
	ac_wl_install();
	$tb    = ac_wl_table();
	$f     = ac_wl_filters();
	$names = ac_wl_names();
	$base  = admin_url( 'admin.php?page=yk-kontak-wa' );
	$keep  = function ( $over = array() ) use ( $f, $base ) {
		$a = array_merge(
			array(
				'd'     => $f['d'],
				'q'     => $f['q'],
				'promo' => $f['promo'] ? 1 : '',
				'staff' => $f['staff'] ? 1 : '',
			),
			$over
		);
		return add_query_arg( array_filter( $a, function ( $v ) { return '' !== $v && null !== $v; } ), $base );
	};
	$from  = $f['d'] ? wp_date( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - $f['d'] * DAY_IN_SECONDS ) : '2000-01-01 00:00:00';
	$sw    = $f['staff'] ? '1=1' : 'staff = 0';

	echo '<div class="wrap"><h1>Kontak WA</h1>';
	echo '<style>.acwla-kpi{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:14px 0}.acwla-kpi div{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dcdcde;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 16px;min-width:150px}.acwla-kpi b{display:block;font-size:24px;margin-top:4px}.acwla-f a{margin-right:4px}.acwla-f a.cur{font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;color:#1d2327}.acwla-t td,.acwla-t th{vertical-align:middle}.acwla-t .wa{display:inline-block;background:#25d366;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:11px;text-decoration:none;margin-left:6px}.acwla-y{color:#138a47;font-weight:600}</style>';
	echo '<p style="max-width:860px">Pembeli yang klik WhatsApp di website wajib mengisi nama depan &amp; nomor WhatsApp (mulai 5 Nov 2026). Satu baris = satu nomor. Kode #W menghubungkan kontak dengan chat di WhatsApp dan laporan <a href="' . esc_url( admin_url( 'admin.php?page=ac-wa-klik' ) ) . '">Klik WhatsApp</a>.</p>';

	// Riwayat satu nomor
	if ( ! empty( $_GET['hp'] ) ) { // phpcs:ignore
		$hp   = preg_replace( '/\D/', '', wp_unslash( $_GET['hp'] ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$hist = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $tb WHERE hp = %s ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200", $hp ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		echo '<p><a href="' . esc_url( $keep() ) . '">&larr; Semua kontak</a></p><h2>' . esc_html( ac_wl_fmt( $hp ) ) . ' <a class="button" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wa.me/' . esc_attr( $hp ) . '">Chat WhatsApp</a></h2>';
		echo '<table class="widefat striped acwla-t"><thead><tr><th>Waktu</th><th>Nama</th><th>Cara</th><th>Ke</th><th>Tombol</th><th>Produk / item</th><th>Halaman</th><th>Sumber</th><th>Perangkat</th><th>Kode</th><th>Promo</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
		foreach ( $hist as $r ) {
			echo '<tr><td>' . esc_html( mysql2date( 'd M Y H:i', $r->t ) ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( $r->nama ) . ( $r->staff ? ' <em>(tes staff)</em>' : '' ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( 'form' === $r->tipe ? 'Isi form' : ( 'co' === $r->tipe ? 'Form' : 'Otomatis (sudah pernah isi)' ) ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( isset( $names[ $r->ke ] ) ? $names[ $r->ke ] : $r->ke ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( $r->btn ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( $r->item ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( $r->page ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( $r->src ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( $r->dev ) . '</td><td>' . ( $r->kode ? '<a href="' . esc_url( admin_url( 'admin.php?page=ac-wa-klik&kode=' . $r->kode ) ) . '">#' . esc_html( $r->kode ) . '</a>' : '–' ) . '</td><td>' . ( $r->promo ? '<span class="acwla-y">Ya</span>' : '–' ) . '</td></tr>';
		}
		echo '</tbody></table></div>';
		return;
	}

	$uniq  = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp) FROM $tb WHERE $sw AND t >= %s", $from ) ); // phpcs:ignore
	$baru  = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT hp FROM $tb WHERE $sw GROUP BY hp HAVING MIN(t) >= %s) x", $from ) ); // phpcs:ignore
	$promo = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT hp FROM $tb WHERE $sw GROUP BY hp HAVING MAX(promo) = 1 AND MAX(t) >= %s) x", $from ) ); // phpcs:ignore
	$chat  = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $tb WHERE $sw AND t >= %s", $from ) ); // phpcs:ignore
	echo '<div class="acwla-kpi"><div>Kontak (nomor unik)<b>' . (int) $uniq . '</b></div><div>Kontak baru<b>' . (int) $baru . '</b></div><div>Mau promo WA<b>' . (int) $promo . '</b></div><div>Total klik chat WA<b>' . (int) $chat . '</b></div></div>';

	echo '<p class="acwla-f">Periode: ';
	foreach ( array( 1 => 'Hari ini (24 jam)', 7 => '7 hari', 30 => '30 hari', 90 => '90 hari', 0 => 'Semua' ) as $d => $lbl ) {
		echo '<a class="' . ( $f['d'] === $d ? 'cur' : '' ) . '" href="' . esc_url( $keep( array( 'd' => $d ) ) ) . '">' . esc_html( $lbl ) . '</a> | ';
	}
	echo '<a class="' . ( $f['promo'] ? 'cur' : '' ) . '" href="' . esc_url( $keep( array( 'promo' => $f['promo'] ? '' : 1 ) ) ) . '">' . ( $f['promo'] ? '&#10003; Hanya yang mau promo' : 'Hanya yang mau promo' ) . '</a>';
	echo '</p><form method="get" style="margin:8px 0 12px"><input type="hidden" name="page" value="ac-kontak-wa"><input type="hidden" name="d" value="' . (int) $f['d'] . '">' . ( $f['promo'] ? '<input type="hidden" name="promo" value="1">' : '' ) . ( $f['staff'] ? '<input type="hidden" name="staff" value="1">' : '' );
	echo '<input type="search" name="q" value="' . esc_attr( $f['q'] ) . '" placeholder="Cari nama / nomor"> <button class="button">Cari</button> ';
	echo '<a class="button button-primary" href="' . esc_url( wp_nonce_url( $keep( array( 'csv' => 1 ) ), 'ac_wl_csv' ) ) . '">Export CSV (sesuai filter)</a> ';
	echo '<a class="button" href="' . esc_url( wp_nonce_url( add_query_arg( array( 'csv' => 1, 'promo' => 1, 'd' => 0 ), $base ), 'ac_wl_csv' ) ) . '">Export untuk WA blast (semua yang mau promo)</a>';
	echo '</form>';

	$pg            = isset( $_GET['pg'] ) ? max( 1, (int) $_GET['pg'] ) : 1; // phpcs:ignore
	list( $rows, $total ) = ac_wl_rows( $f, 100, ( $pg - 1 ) * 100 );
	echo '<table class="widefat striped acwla-t"><thead><tr><th>Nama</th><th>No. WhatsApp</th><th>Pertama kontak</th><th>Terakhir</th><th>Chat</th><th>Terakhir ke</th><th>Tombol / produk terakhir</th><th>Sumber awal</th><th>Promo</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
	if ( ! $rows ) {
		echo '<tr><td colspan="9">Belum ada data untuk filter ini.</td></tr>';
	}
	foreach ( $rows as $r ) {
		$hl = $keep( array( 'hp' => $r->hp ) );
		echo '<tr><td><a href="' . esc_url( $hl ) . '"><b>' . esc_html( $r->nama ) . '</b></a></td>'
			. '<td>' . esc_html( ac_wl_fmt( $r->hp ) ) . '<a class="wa" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://wa.me/' . esc_attr( $r->hp ) . '">Chat</a></td>'
			. '<td>' . esc_html( mysql2date( 'd M Y H:i', $r->t1 ) ) . '</td><td>' . esc_html( mysql2date( 'd M Y H:i', $r->t2 ) ) . '</td>'
			. '<td><a href="' . esc_url( $hl ) . '">' . (int) $r->n . 'x</a></td>'
			. '<td>' . esc_html( isset( $names[ $r->ke ] ) ? $names[ $r->ke ] : $r->ke ) . '</td>'
			. '<td>' . esc_html( $r->btn ) . ( $r->lastp ? '<br><small>' . esc_html( $r->lastp ) . '</small>' : '' ) . '</td>'
			. '<td>' . esc_html( $r->src ) . '</td><td>' . ( $r->promo ? '<span class="acwla-y">Ya</span>' : '–' ) . '</td></tr>';
	}
	echo '</tbody></table>';
	$pages = (int) ceil( $total / 100 );
	if ( $pages > 1 ) {
		echo '<p>Halaman: ';
		for ( $i = 1; $i <= $pages; $i++ ) {
			echo $i === $pg ? '<b>' . (int) $i . '</b> ' : '<a href="' . esc_url( $keep( array( 'pg' => $i ) ) ) . '">' . (int) $i . '</a> '; // phpcs:ignore
		}
		echo '</p>';
	}
	echo '<p style="color:#666;margin-top:14px">' . (int) $total . ' nomor. Klik nama untuk melihat riwayat chat per nomor. Data tes staff disembunyikan (<a href="' . esc_url( $keep( array( 'staff' => $f['staff'] ? '' : 1 ) ) ) . '">' . ( $f['staff'] ? 'sembunyikan' : 'tampilkan' ) . '</a>).</p></div>';
}
